title: Mountain Blue home page
summary: Mountain Blue's home page, describing the business as an Australian blueberry grower and breeder at Lindendale, New South Wales, and giving a founding year of 1978.
why_it_matters: Establishes the corporate identity and location of the second major private breeding programme in this package, and supplies the founding year that conflicts with the company's own history page.

reading.rationale: Baseline corporate facts for a primary breeder.

commercial_position.rationale: Identifies the breeder behind a widely licensed genetics family.
